Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [D-Reaper] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.

[Main] By returning this Tamer to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 play cost 3 or lower Digimon card with the [D-Reaper] trait from your hand without paying the cost. For each of your [Mother D-Reaper]'s digivolution cards, add 1 to this effect's play cost maximum.
